exposure: Adolescent pregnancy (defined as maternal age <20 years)
cohort: 1,331 adolescent mothers and 12,853 adult mothers who had deliveries at the Department of Obstetrics.
finding: Adolescent mothers experienced a higher incidence of preterm birth, operative vaginal delivery, lower birth weight, height, and head circumference in infants, and a greater risk of low birth weight and stillbirth compared to adult mothers.
gest_age: Not mentioned, but delivery week was recorded
